layman_headline: Extreme fear grips the crypto market — sitting on the sidelines until the dust settles.
layman_explanation: The overall mood in crypto is at 'Extreme Fear' (25 out of 100) and getting worse day by day. Bitcoin is holding steady around $64,000 but altcoins are getting hammered — some candidates are down 13-25% in a single week. The few coins showing upward momentum (like BTW up 44% and PUMP up 24%) have already run too far and are risky to chase. None of the swing trade candidates have enough reliable technical data (RSI, MACD, chart patterns) to build a high-confidence setup.
layman_action: Do nothing right now. The market is in panic mode and the best swing trade candidates either lack enough data to evaluate properly or have already moved too much. Wait for fear to stabilize or reverse before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated Rule #3: when Fear and Greed is at 25 or below, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous, and the safest call is HOLD. Rule #7 notes that at F&G 22 or lower, BTC tends to drift down another 1-4%, and we are at 25 with a worsening trend. Of the seven swing candidates, only LDO has any RSI data (42.71 — neutral, not oversold) and chart analysis (neutral bias at -0.10). LDO's -25.2% weekly drop looks like a potential mean-reversion play, but with BTC dominance at 56.5% crushing alts and no funding rate, MACD, or volume confirmation available, the setup lacks the multi-signal confluence required for a high-confidence entry. BTW (+44.3%) and PUMP (+23.6%) are extended and likely to retrace. UB dropped 32.8% in 24 hours with zero technical data — untouchable. The signal credibility data shows RSI is my most reliable indicator (71% win rate), but only LDO even has an RSI reading and it's not in oversold territory. I refuse to force a trade in this environment.
risk_factors: Fear and Greed at 25 and worsening — could drop further triggering cascading altcoin selloffs
BTC dominance at 56.5% actively suppressing altcoin performance — wrong environment for alt swing trades
Most candidates lack basic technical data (RSI, MACD, funding rates) making any entry essentially a blind gamble
watch_list: Fear and Greed Index — watch for stabilization above 30 or further deterioration below 22
LDO price action near $0.30 support — if RSI drops below 30 with a bullish MACD cross, this becomes actionable
BTC behavior at $63,000 support level identified by Glassnode — a breakdown here would invalidate all alt setups
market_context: Crypto markets are in Extreme Fear (25/100, worsening trend) with BTC holding at $64K while altcoins bleed. BTC dominance at 56.5% signals capital rotation away from alts, making this a hostile environment for altcoin swing trades.
context_banner: Extreme Fear at 25 with a worsening trend and high BTC dominance — disciplined traders wait for panic to exhaust before deploying capital.
